name: Real Estate With Shirin
description: Customer-facing practice of licensed Northern Idaho REALTOR® and Seniors Real Estate Specialist (SRES®) Shirin Abplanalp at Berkshire Hathaway HomeServices Jacklin Real Estate. She helps buyers, sellers, and relocating families in Post Falls, Coeur d'Alene, Hayden, Rathdrum, and Sandpoint. Luxury and commercial work are referrals through the brokerage, not services this practice performs. 11 years of experience, 100+ transactions closed. Contact is a request for a conversation, not an instant booking.
